cards.subtitle: Deterministic Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz (1686), Johann Bernoulli (1710) & Leonhard Euler Vis-Viva orbital energy conservation equation (v^2 = mu * (2/r - 1/a), boosting periapsis kinetic energy at r_p = a*(1 - e) to v_p^2 = v_circ^2 * (1 + e) and locking Ek_exact / Ek_model = 1.0000x across all 17 eccentricity stations e in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive circular-orbit velocity (v_circ^2 = mu / r_p, which underestimates periapsis kinetic energy by 1 + e to 1.2500x at S4 e=0.25, 1.5000x at S8 e=0.50, and 2.0000x at parabolic escape S16 e=1.00 across 16/17 stations) and 64-step Newtonian radial work quadrature.
